item.title: D-Wave advances quantum error correction
item.summary: D-Wave has demonstrated a two-qubit gate designed to cut the hardware overhead of quantum error correction in future gate-model computers. The peer-reviewed research, published in Nature, reports high-fidelity operation while retaining the error-detection benefits of the company’s superconducting dual-rail qubit architecture.
